metadata.name: meridian
metadata.description: Meridian: binary stock-outcome contracts on Solana

instructions.name: accept_admin
docs: Instruction 3 (§6), second step: the proposed admin accepts.

instructions.name: buy_no
docs: Instruction 11 (§6): mints pairs and sells their Yes, keeping the No (D5, D39).

instructions.name: cancel_order
docs: Instruction 13 (§6): the owner cancels a resting order; never paused (D68, D99).

instructions.name: close_book
docs: Instruction 17 (§6): anyone closes a settled, empty book (D50).

instructions.name: create_market
docs: Instruction 6 (§6): the operator or the admin creates a market, before its open, with its named Yes and No
mints, its vault, its book and the book's token accounts.

accounts.name: creator
docs: The operator or the admin (D24); pays every deposit.

instructions.name: finalize
docs: Instruction 23 (§6): anyone, after the proposal's wait.

instructions.name: hold
docs: Instruction 20 (§6): the admin holds a market before it settles (D68).

instructions.name: initialize_config
docs: Instruction 1 (ARCHITECTURE.md §6): creates Config, once, signed by the program's upgrade key (AR.03).

accounts.name: authority
docs: Signs and pays the deposit.

accounts.name: program
docs: The upgrade-key gate (AR.03): this program's own ProgramData, whose upgrade key signed.

instructions.name: mint_pairs
docs: Instruction 8 (§6): 1.00 USDC into the vault for each pair of Yes and No, while minting is open (D43, D46).

instructions.name: pause
docs: Instruction 5 (§6): pause stops minting and new orders, nothing else (D68).

instructions.name: place_order
docs: Instruction 10 (§6): within the market's order window, matches on its book and moves the taker's tokens.

accounts.name: yes_mint
docs: one not owned by the token program it is sent to, which covers §5's token-account rule for every account here.

instructions.name: propose_admin
docs: Instruction 3 (§6), first step: the admin proposes a new admin key (D109).

instructions.name: propose_result
docs: Instruction 21 (§6): the admin proposes a result from the official close (D63, D104).

instructions.name: record_close
docs: Instruction 18 (§6): anyone records or improves a stock's close (D105).

instructions.name: redeem
docs: Instruction 9 (§6): pairs back for 1.00 each before the result (D38); winning and losing tokens after it.

accounts.name: holder
docs: Receives the USDC, and the deposits of any account emptied here (D94).

instructions.name: remove_market
docs: Instruction 7 (§6): the admin removes a market before 9:00 (D53, D140).

accounts.name: creator_usdc
docs: can close (D137).

instructions.name: replace_quotes
docs: Instruction 14 (§6): a maker's batch across books (D111).

instructions.name: return_to_owner
docs: Instruction 16 (§6): anyone pays an owner's book balance to the owner's own accounts (D99).

instructions.name: sell_no
docs: Instruction 12 (§6): buys Yes and closes pairs; never rests (D38).

instructions.name: set_operator
docs: Instruction 4 (§6): the admin rotates the operator key (D27).

instructions.name: settle
docs: Instruction 19 (§6): settles from the record, or puts the market under review (D58, D68).

instructions.name: sweep
docs: Instruction 15 (§6): the operator's close sweep (D37).

instructions.name: update_config
docs: Instruction 2 (§6): the admin changes thresholds, tickers, receivers, the ladder or the fill limit (D49, M1.01).

instructions.name: withdraw_proposal
docs: Instruction 22 (§6).

errors.name: NotUpgradeAuthority
errors.msg: Only the program's upgrade key may initialize the config

errors.name: MainnetUsdcOnDevnet
errors.msg: The devnet build refuses mainnet USDC

errors.name: MissingKey
errors.msg: A key in the config is missing

errors.name: InvalidReceivers
errors.msg: Accepted price programs: one or two, distinct, none missing

errors.name: InvalidTickers
errors.msg: Tickers: one to eight, distinct, 1 to 8 capital letters, a feed ID and a strike step each

errors.name: InvalidLadder
errors.msg: The strike ladder must be 1 to 50 percent, in rising order

errors.name: InvalidThresholds
errors.msg: A threshold is out of range

errors.name: InvalidPrice
errors.msg: Prices are 1 to 99 cents

errors.name: InvalidQuantity
errors.msg: Quantities must be above 0

errors.name: BookFull
errors.msg: This market's order book is full.

errors.name: DuplicateOrderId
errors.msg: An order with this ID is already resting

errors.name: FillLimitNotSet
errors.msg: The fill limit is not set

errors.name: Paused
errors.msg: Trading is paused by the admin. You can still cancel orders, close pairs and redeem.

errors.name: BookShort
errors.msg: The book's token accounts hold less than its orders and balances

errors.name: DuplicateAccount
errors.msg: An account is passed twice

errors.name: NotImplemented
errors.msg: Not built yet

errors.name: NotOperator
errors.msg: Not the operator

errors.name: TickerNotEnabled
errors.msg: This stock isn't enabled in the config

errors.name: InvalidStrike
errors.msg: The strike must be above zero and a multiple of the stock's step

errors.name: InvalidTimes
errors.msg: Minting must open no later than the open, and the open come before orders close

errors.name: CreateAfterOpen
errors.msg: A market must be created before it opens

errors.name: NotOpenYet
errors.msg: Not open yet

errors.name: OrdersClosed
errors.msg: Trading ended before your order reached the network. Nothing was bought; only the network fee was charged.

errors.name: MarketSettled
errors.msg: Pairs can be closed only before the result is final

errors.name: NotFinal
errors.msg: Redeem opens when the result is final.

errors.name: VaultShort
errors.msg: The vault holds less than the market owes

errors.name: SupplyOverOwed
errors.msg: A token's supply is above what the market owes

errors.name: NotYourAccount
errors.msg: A token account belongs to someone else

errors.name: NotAdmin
errors.msg: Not the admin

errors.name: NotPendingAdmin
errors.msg: Only the proposed admin can accept

errors.name: FillLimitTooHigh
errors.msg: The fill limit is 1 to 32 (M1.01)

errors.name: OrderNotFound
errors.msg: No resting order of yours has that ID

errors.name: RemoveTooLate
errors.msg: Strikes can be removed only before 9:00 AM ET, before anyone can trade.

errors.name: WaitNotOver
errors.msg: The proposal's wait isn't over

errors.name: PriceNotGenuine
errors.msg: The price account isn't a verified Pyth update from an accepted receiver

errors.name: WrongFeed
errors.msg: The price account is for another feed

errors.name: OutsideWindow
errors.msg: The price was published outside the window before the close

errors.name: BandTooWide
errors.msg: The price's band is too wide

errors.name: BeforeClose
errors.msg: The close hasn't happened yet

errors.name: AlreadySettled
errors.msg: The market already has a result

errors.name: BookNotEmpty
errors.msg: The book still has orders or balances

errors.name: NotUnderReview
errors.msg: The market isn't under review

errors.name: NoProposal
errors.msg: There is no proposal

errors.name: SourceTooLong
errors.msg: The source is longer than 32 bytes

errors.name: PriceNotLater
errors.msg: A recorded close is replaced only by a later price

errors.name: RecordFrozen
errors.msg: The recorded close is frozen: a market of this stock has settled on it

types.name: BalanceReturned
docs: An owner's balance in the book paid to its own accounts: USDC, Yes, and No released from paired offers (D99, D142,

fields.name: next_seq
docs: The next order's sequence number, for time priority.

fields.name: bids
docs: Highest price first, then oldest.

fields.name: asks
docs: Lowest price first, then oldest.

types.name: BookQuotes
docs: The new orders for one book. The books' accounts follow in the remaining accounts, six per book in this order:
the market, its book, the book's USDC and Yes accounts, the Yes mint, and the maker's own Yes account. Replace
quotes cancels the maker's plain orders only; a paired offer stays until Cancel order or the sweep (D142).

fields.name: price
docs: The most the taker pays per No, in cents: it sells each new pair's Yes for at least 100 minus this (D15).

types.name: CloseRecorded
docs: A stock's close recorded or improved (D105).

fields.name: admin
docs: Runs the admin instructions (D24). A key file on the laptop on devnet (D92).

fields.name: pending_admin
docs: The proposed next admin, until they accept (two-step rotation, D109).

fields.name: operator
docs: The backend's key: creates markets and settles, but can't pause or override (A5).

fields.name: usdc_mint
docs: The dollar token. Circle's devnet USDC on devnet (D32).

fields.name: pyth_receivers
docs: Programs whose price accounts are accepted: Pyth's legacy and upgraded receivers (D80).

fields.name: tickers
docs: The stocks, each pinned to its regular-session feed (D55, D28).

fields.name: ladder_bps
docs: Strike offsets from the previous close, in basis points: ±3, 6 and 9% (D6, D49).

fields.name: paused
docs: Stops Mint pairs and Place order only (D68).

fields.name: fill_limit
docs: The most fills one order may take. Set from M1's order-book spike; 0 until then (D21).

types.name: ConfigInitialized
docs: Instruction 1's event (ARCHITECTURE.md §6).

types.name: ConfigUpdated
docs: Config's settings after a change, in full, so the record shows what changed (D70).

fields.name: day
docs: yyyymmdd, New York.

types.name: Fill
docs: The taker's order traded with one resting order, at that order's price (D42).

fields.name: taker_order_id
docs: The taker's order ID; 0 for Sell No, whose arguments have none (D143).

fields.name: side
docs: What the taker did with Yes.

types.name: HoldReason
docs: Why a market is Under review (D59, D68, D83).

fields.name: ticker
docs: The stock, as in Config: 1 to 8 capital letters, zero-padded.

fields.name: day
docs: The trading day in New York, as yyyymmdd.

fields.name: mint_open
docs: Minting opens (9:00, D46), orders open (9:30), and the stored close; Unix seconds.

fields.name: owed
docs: D64: pairs outstanding before settlement, unredeemed winning tokens after. The vault holds at least this many
USDC, and no token supply exceeds it.

fields.name: price
docs: The price it settled on, with its band and publish time, in Pyth's units (D105).

fields.name: creator
docs: Who paid the deposits: the operator or the admin, whichever created it (D24). Close book returns the book's
deposits here (D50), whoever sends it, even after the operator key changes.

fields.name: bump
docs: The bumps of the market's own address and of its Yes mint, No mint and vault; the book keeps its own.

fields.name: feed_id
docs: The stock's Pyth feed when the market was created: a later config change can't move today's settlement to
another feed (D49).

types.name: MarketCreated
docs: A market and its accounts exist (§6, instruction 6).

fields.name: note
docs: The admin's public note on an admin hold (D70, D91); empty otherwise.

types.name: MarketStatus
docs: What a decision has made of the market. Before any decision it is Trading, and the clock says whether that means
Upcoming, Open or Closed (§4).

types.name: Order
docs: A resting order (24 bytes): a bid locks price × quantity in USDC, an offer locks quantity in Yes, and a paired
offer's No wait in the book's No account (D142).

fields.name: order_id
docs: The ID its sender chose (D101).

fields.name: trader
docs: The owner's index in the trader table.

fields.name: price
docs: In cents, 1 to 99.

fields.name: flags
docs: PAIRED, or 0.

types.name: OrderCancelled
docs: A resting order left the book. What it locked waits in its owner's book balance (D99), except after a self-trade,
when it goes back to the wallet (D90). A paired offer's cancel is followed by Redeemed (pairs) for the pairs it
closed (D142, D143).

fields.name: side
docs: The resting order's side: a bid buys Yes, an offer sells it.

types.name: OrderKind
docs: A Market order fills what it can now and the rest is not placed; a Limit order's rest rests at its price (§3).

types.name: OrderPlaced
docs: A Limit order's remainder now rests on the book. For Buy No, the unsold pairs' Yes rest as a paired offer and
their No wait in the book (D142).

types.name: PairsMinted
docs: `quantity` pairs minted: that many USDC into the vault, that many Yes and No to the owner (§6, instruction 8).

fields.name: price
docs: A Limit order's price, or a Market order's worst price (D15), in cents.

types.name: Proposal
docs: The admin's proposed result while Under review (D63, D104).

fields.name: official_close_cents
docs: The exchange's official close, in cents.

fields.name: source
docs: Where the official close came from, as text, zero-padded.

types.name: Quote
docs: One order in a maker's batch.

types.name: Redeemed
docs: Tokens redeemed or burned, and the USDC paid: Redeem (§6, instruction 9), Sell No's pair close (12), and a paired
offer's cancel (13), whose USDC goes to the owner's book balance (D143).

fields.name: source
docs: Where the official close came from, kept here because a re-proposal overwrites the market's copy.

fields.name: price
docs: The most it pays per Yes bought, in cents; Sell No never rests (D38).

types.name: Side
docs: What the order does with Yes. Buy No sells Yes and Sell No buys it (D5, D38).

types.name: Thresholds
docs: The times and limits the program enforces, with ARCHITECTURE.md §11's devnet values.

fields.name: orders_close_before_secs
docs: Orders close this long before the stored close: 5 s (D102).

fields.name: publish_window_secs
docs: A recorded price must be published within this of the close: 5 s (D103).

fields.name: max_band_bps
docs: The widest price band accepted: 25 basis points (D106).

fields.name: override_bound_bps
docs: An override within this of the reference waits the short wait: 0.5% (D104).

fields.name: override_wait_secs
docs: The short wait before an override is final: 1 hour (D63, D104).

fields.name: override_wait_long_secs
docs: The wait outside the bound, or with no reference: 24 hours (D104).

fields.name: operator_only_settle_secs
docs: Only the operator may settle for this long after the close: 24 hours (D58).

fields.name: admin_hold_backstop_secs
docs: An admin hold lapses after this: 24 hours (D68).

fields.name: band_hold_backstop_secs
docs: A band-on-the-strike hold lapses after this: 7 days (D68).

fields.name: no_price_hold_after_secs
docs: With no recorded price this long after the close, the market is held: 15 minutes (D83).

fields.name: symbol
docs: "META": 1 to 8 capital letters.

fields.name: feed_id
docs: Pyth's 32-byte feed ID for the stock's regular-session price (Equity.US.<ticker>/USD).

fields.name: strike_step_cents
docs: Strikes are multiples of this, in cents: $10 is 1000 (D49).

fields.name: enabled
docs: New markets only for enabled stocks.

types.name: Trader
docs: A trader with resting orders or free balances (64 bytes). Reused once its three balances (USDC, Yes, No) are zero
and it has no open orders (D107, D142).

fields.name: free_usdc
docs: USDC credited by fills and cancels, waiting for Return to owner (D99), in its smallest units.

fields.name: free_no
docs: No released from the owner's paired offers as they sell (D142).

types.name: UpdateConfigArgs
docs: Each field that is set replaces Config's; the rest stay. Tickers and the ladder shape the next markets created;
a market keeps the strike, times and feed it was created with (D49, D53, D139).
